results.description:
I am not 100% what type of Fern this is, but I am sure that it is indeed a type of Fern. I found this in front of my garden that is located behind my estate. This specific fern is not as shiny as other ferns are described as. The browning on the edges can be related to excess rainfall and slowly rotting away due to time and season. This fern has a lot of ridges and is a consistent green colored plant. This fern was pretty small in size but ferns differ in size. This is a seedless vascular plant. Ferns, according to Libretext, reproduces with spores instead of seeds.
